description: An iterator from a key whose place is past its collection's size, which only a clone with fewer in its header than in its tree has. The port's starting descent takes what's left as the size less the key's place, or nothing when the place is at or past the size, so it gives nothing.

ops.note: a clone whose header says 41 under a tree of 51
k34's place in the tree is past the size
from the key whose place is the size, both give nothing
the port gives nothing from a key whose place is at or past the size
